protocol.objective: Measure one shared exact candidate verifier against existing independent WASM verifier workers on real files
protocol.production_changes: None: separate experimental crate, worker, driver and measurement script; no global isolation or backend changes
protocol.correctness: Identical f64 distances, f32 display bits, ordered summary fields and certified counts for identical real WebGPU hints; invalid hints, failed replacement and release checked
protocol.timing: Separate initialization/preparation, fixed-hint verification and full GPU pipeline requests; five warmups and ten rotated paired trials; no heavy builds during measurements
protocol.inputs: Unmodified even/odd XYZ subsets of existing PandaSet 019 and Autoware planning measured clouds, checked against previous immutable input manifests; no downloads
protocol.initial_measurements: Four reports: two independent runs for each dataset with four verification threads; at most four additional thread-count reports if justified
protocol.toolchain: Scoped nightly-2026-10-20 with rebuilt atomic std; wasm-bindgen-rayon 1.3.0; stable serial fallback
protocol.cleanup: Remove only experiment-owned target, toolchain and prepared input copies after preserving source, metadata, logs and reports
protocol.old_studies: Closed studies and published historical measurements remain unchanged

orderRevision.reason: Initial cyclic rotations preserve most immediate predecessors: shared usually follows the slow serial control. GPU waits around 480 ms occurred in long requests; causal attribution to shared verification is not established. Balance predecessor order before interpreting end-to-end effects.
orderRevision.unchanged: Same WASM packages, production binary, driver, input files, threads, batch size, warmups and repeats
orderRevision.new_order: Williams design across four rows: every mode occurs once in each position and every directed within-row predecessor pair occurs once. Ten trials contain two complete blocks plus two rows; exact aggregate balance is not claimed.
orderRevision.analysis: Publish both phases separately, all trials and long requests retained; compare fixed-hint and full-GPU times, paired ratios, maxima and phase waits; no default integration based on noisy medians

analysis.pairedPercent: median(100 * (shared elapsed / baseline elapsed - 1)) within each trial; a negative number is faster. This is not a ratio of separate medians.
analysis.initialPhase: First four reports use cyclic rotations, which retain most immediate predecessors. These original reports and all long requests remain published.
analysis.balancedPhase: Last four reports use a four-row Williams design. Each full block balances ordinal positions and all directed predecessor pairs. Ten measured rows contain two blocks plus two rows and are not exactly balanced in aggregate.
analysis.unchangedBetweenPhases: All three binary packages, production WASM, inputs, shader, driver, thread count, batch size, warmups and repeats; only the Node/page timing schedule changed.
analysis.coldField: Raw measurements.*.cold are validation requests after preparation and guard diagnostics; shared fixed verification has already run during a guard check. They are not fresh-process cold-job measurements. Initialization and import stages are separate and have different boundaries. No whole cold-job speedup is claimed.
analysis.precision: Untimed controls compare every f64 bit with complete existing search and compare stable serial, same-binary serial, pool and shared results. Every timed trial compares displayed f32 bits, all ordered f64 summary fields and certified counts.
analysis.waitIntervals: gpuWaitMillis is host waiting for result promises, not a GPU timestamp or kernel duration. It includes scheduling/readback. It can overlap prefetched verification intervals; do not sum them.
analysis.memory: Snapshot and query byte fields describe transferred input payloads, not tree allocation or RSS. Pool imports four trees; shared imports one. Staged pool and shared transfer the same total query payload. Committed WASM bytes are high-water counters; all controls coexist, so whole-application memory savings are not measured.
analysis.decision: Keep the standalone experiment and counterbalanced benchmark. Full-GPU gains are small; fixed-hint comparison with staged pool changes direction between repeats. Browser wait tails and host variation prevent a production default recommendation. No automatic selection, production cache integration or failure recovery is added.
analysis.preparedJobScope: Reference imports, owner query snapshots and staged query preparation occur once, outside timed requests. The driver reuses the same immutable job. Production creates query jobs per C2C operation. These are retained-job pipeline experiments, not complete application-operation measurements.
